PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?patient) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?patient a med:Patient .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?patient med:hasEncounter ?enc .
    ?enc med:recordedOn ?date .
    BIND(?date AS ?optDate)
  }
  FILTER(?optDate >= "2024-06-01"^^xsd:date)
  OPTIONAL { ?patient med:hasMedication ?med . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?entity) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?target { "DX-200" "DX-201" }
  { ?entity a med:Condition ; med:code ?code . }
  UNION
  { ?entity a med:Medication ; med:code ?code . }
  FILTER(?code = ?target || ?code = "DX-202")
  OPTIONAL { ?entity med:code ?alt . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?practitioner (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?encCount) WHERE {
  ?enc a med:Encounter ; med:handledBy ?practitioner ; med:recordedOn ?date .
  FILTER(?date IN ("2024-01-01"^^xsd:date, "2024-02-01"^^xsd:date))
  OPTIONAL { ?enc med:hasCondition ?cond . }
}
GROUP BY ?practitioner
HAVING(COUNT(?enc) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?patient) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?patient a med:Patient .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?patient med:hasEncounter/med:hasObservation ?obs .
    ?obs med:value ?value .
    BIND(?value AS ?optValue)
  }
  FILTER(?optValue > 60)
  MINUS { ?patient med:name ?name . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), "test")) }
}

PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?enc a med:Encounter ; med:hasCondition ?cond .
  ?cond med:code ?code .
  FILTER(?code = "DX-200" || ?code = "DX-201")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?enc med:hasObservation ?obs . }
  OPTIONAL { ?enc med:handledBy ?practitioner . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?patient) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?limit { 55 }
  ?patient a med:Patient ; med:hasEncounter ?enc .
  ?enc med:hasObservation ?obs .
  ?obs med:value ?value .
  FILTER(?value IN (50, 60, 70))
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?enc med:hasCondition ?cond . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?patient (COUNT(DISTINCT ?med) AS ?medCount) WHERE {
  { ?patient a med:Patient . }
  UNION
  { ?patient med:hasEncounter ?enc . }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?patient med:hasMedication ?med .
    BIND(?med AS ?optMed)
  }
  FILTER(?optMed != ?patient)
}
GROUP BY ?patient
HAVING(COUNT(?med) > 0)

SELECT ?patient (COUNT(DISTINCT ?med) AS ?medCount) WHERE {
  {
    ?patient a <http://example.com/theme/medical/Patient> .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?patient <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasEncounter> ?enc .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?patient <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasMedication> ?med .
    BIND(?med AS ?optMed)
  }
  FILTER (?optMed != ?patient)
}
GROUP BY ?patient
HAVING (COUNT(?med) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?med) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?med a med:Medication ; med:code ?code .
  FILTER(?code = "MED-1000" || ?code = "MED-1001")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?patient med:hasMedication ?med . }
  MINUS { ?med med:dosage ?dose . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?dose)), "x")) }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?patient (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?encCount) WHERE {
  ?patient a med:Patient .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?patient med:hasEncounter ?enc .
    ?enc med:handledBy ?practitioner .
    BIND(?practitioner AS ?optPractitioner)
  }
  FILTER(?optPractitioner != ?patient)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?enc med:hasCondition ?cond . }
}
GROUP BY ?patient
HAVING(COUNT(?enc) >= 2)

SELECT ?patient (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?encCount) WHERE {
  ?patient a <http://example.com/theme/medical/Patient> .
  ?patient <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasEncounter> ?enc .
  ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/handledBy> ?practitioner .
  BIND(?practitioner AS ?optPractitioner)
  FILTER ((?optPractitioner != ?patient) && EXISTS { ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasCondition> ?cond . })
}
GROUP BY ?patient
HAVING (COUNT(?enc) >= 2)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?code { "DX-200" "DX-201" }
  ?enc a med:Encounter ; med:hasCondition ?cond .
  ?cond med:code ?condCode .
  FILTER(?condCode IN ("DX-200", "DX-201", "DX-202"))
  OPTIONAL { ?enc med:handledBy ?practitioner . }
  MINUS { ?enc med:hasObservation ?obs . ?obs med:value ?value . FILTER(?value < 60) }
}

         Count (Distinct)
            Var (name=enc) (bindingState=unbound)

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?code { "DX-200" "DX-201" }
  ?cond <http://example.com/theme/medical/code> ?condCode .
  FILTER (?condCode IN ("DX-200", "DX-201", "DX-202"))
  ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasCondition> ?cond .
  ?enc a <http://example.com/theme/medical/Encounter> .
  MINUS {
    ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasObservation> ?obs .
    {
      {
        ?obs <http://example.com/theme/medical/value> ?value .
        FILTER (?value < 60)
      }
    }
  }
}

PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?patient) AS ?count) WHERE {
  { ?patient a med:Patient ; med:hasMedication ?med . }
  UNION
  { ?patient a med:Patient ; med:hasEncounter ?enc . ?enc med:hasObservation ?obs . }
  OPTIONAL { ?patient med:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(?optName != "")
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?patient med:hasMedication ?m2 . ?m2 med:code ?c .
                      FILTER(?c = "MED-1005") }
}

PREFIX social: <http://example.com/theme/social/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?u1) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?u1 { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/0>
               <http://example.com/theme/social/user/1>
               <http://example.com/theme/social/user/2> }
  VALUES ?u2 { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/0>
               <http://example.com/theme/social/user/1>
               <http://example.com/theme/social/user/2> }
  VALUES ?u3 { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/0>
               <http://example.com/theme/social/user/1>
               <http://example.com/theme/social/user/2> }
  FILTER(?u1 != ?u2 && ?u1 != ?u3 && ?u2 != ?u3)
  ?u1 social:follows ?u2 .
  ?u2 social:follows ?u1 .
  ?u1 social:follows ?u3 .
  ?u3 social:follows ?u1 .
  ?u2 social:follows ?u3 .
  ?u3 social:follows ?u2 .
  FILTER EXISTS { ?u1 social:name ?name .
                  FILTER(?name = "user0" || ?name = "user1") }
  MINUS { ?u1 social:follows ?u1 . }
}

PREFIX social: <http://example.com/theme/social/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?u (COUNT(DISTINCT ?v) AS ?degree) WHERE {
  VALUES ?u { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/3>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/4>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/5>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/6> }
  VALUES ?v { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/3>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/4>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/5>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/6> }
  FILTER(?u != ?v)
  ?u social:follows ?v .
  OPTIONAL { ?u social:name ?optName . BIND(?optName AS ?optAlias) }
  FILTER(?optAlias IN ("user3", "user4", "user5", "user6"))
}
GROUP BY ?u
HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?v) >= 3)

  FILTER(?u != ?v)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX social: <http://example.com/theme/social/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?activity) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?u { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/7>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/8>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/9>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/10>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/11> }
  {
    ?u social:follows ?v .
    ?v social:follows ?u .
    BIND(?v AS ?activity)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?post social:authored ?u .
    BIND(?post AS ?activity)
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?u social:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(?optName IN ("user7", "user8", "user9", "user10", "user11"))
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX social: <http://example.com/theme/social/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?u (COUNT(DISTINCT ?v) AS ?connections) WHERE {
  VALUES ?u { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/12>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/13>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/14>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/15>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/16>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/17> }
  VALUES ?v { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/12>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/13>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/14>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/15>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/16>
              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/17> }
  FILTER(?u != ?v)
  ?u social:follows ?v .
  OPTIONAL { ?u social:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(?optName != "")
}
GROUP BY ?u
HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?v) >= 5)

PREFIX social: <http://example.com/theme/social/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a) AS ?count) WHERE {

              <http://example.com/theme/social/user/5>

  ?a social:follows ?b .
  ?b social:follows ?c .
  ?c social:follows ?d .
  ?d social:follows ?a .
  OPTIONAL { ?b social:name ?optName . BIND(?optName AS ?optAlias) }
  FILTER(?optAlias != "")
}

  VALUES ?e { <http://example.com/theme/social/user/7>

  FILTER(?a != ?b && ?b != ?c && ?c != ?d && ?d != ?e && ?a != ?c)
  ?a social:follows ?b .

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?book) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?book a lib:Book .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?book lib:hasCopy ?copy .
    ?copy lib:locatedAt ?branch .
    BIND(?branch AS ?optBranch)
  }
  FILTER(?optBranch != ?book)
  OPTIONAL { ?book lib:writtenBy ?author . }
}

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?entity) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?target { "Member 1" "Member 2" }
  { ?entity a lib:Member ; lib:name ?name . }
  UNION
  { ?entity a lib:Book ; lib:title ?name . }
  FILTER(?name = ?target || ?name = "Member 3")
  OPTIONAL { ?entity lib:hasCopy ?copy . }
}

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?author (COUNT(DISTINCT ?book) AS ?bookCount) WHERE {
  ?author a lib:Author ; lib:name ?authorName .
  FILTER(?authorName IN ("Author 1", "Author 2", "Author 3"))
  OPTIONAL { ?book lib:writtenBy ?author . }
}
GROUP BY ?author
HAVING(COUNT(?book) > 0)

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?book) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?book a lib:Book ; lib:title ?title .
  FILTER(?title = "Book 1" || ?title = "Book 2")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?book lib:hasCopy ?copy . }
  OPTIONAL { ?book lib:writtenBy ?author . }

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?book) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?book a <http://example.com/theme/library/Book> .
  VALUES ?title { "Book 1" "Book 2" }
  ?book <http://example.com/theme/library/title> ?title .
  FILTER EXISTS {
    ?book <http://example.com/theme/library/hasCopy> ?copy .
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?member (COUNT(DISTINCT ?loan) AS ?loanCount) WHERE {
  ?loan a lib:Loan ; lib:borrowedBy ?member .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?loan lib:loanedCopy ?copy .
    BIND(?copy AS ?optCopy)
  }
  FILTER(?optCopy != ?member)
}
GROUP BY ?member
HAVING(COUNT(?loan) > 0)

SELECT ?member (COUNT(DISTINCT ?loan) AS ?loanCount) WHERE {
  ?loan a <http://example.com/theme/library/Loan> .
  ?loan <http://example.com/theme/library/borrowedBy> ?member .
  ?loan <http://example.com/theme/library/loanedCopy> ?copy .

}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?copy) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?copy a lib:Copy ; lib:locatedAt ?branch .
  ?branch lib:name ?branchName .
  FILTER(?branchName = "Branch 0" || ?branchName = "Branch 1")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?copy a lib:Copy . }
  MINUS { ?copy lib:locatedAt ?branch . FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?branch), "branch/0")) }
}

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?author (COUNT(DISTINCT ?loan) AS ?loanCount) WHERE {
  ?book a lib:Book ; lib:writtenBy ?author ; lib:hasCopy ?copy .
  ?copy lib:locatedAt ?branch .
  ?loan a lib:Loan ; lib:loanedCopy ?copy ; lib:borrowedBy ?member .
  OPTIONAL { ?member lib:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(?optName IN ("Member 1", "Member 2", "Member 3"))
}
GROUP BY ?author
HAVING(COUNT(?loan) > 0)

SELECT ?author (COUNT(DISTINCT ?loan) AS ?loanCount) WHERE {
  VALUES ?optName { "Member 1" "Member 2" "Member 3" }
  ?member <http://example.com/theme/library/name> ?optName .
  ?loan <http://example.com/theme/library/borrowedBy> ?member .
  ?loan a <http://example.com/theme/library/Loan> .
  ?loan <http://example.com/theme/library/loanedCopy> ?copy .
  ?book <http://example.com/theme/library/hasCopy> ?copy .
  ?book a <http://example.com/theme/library/Book> .
  ?book <http://example.com/theme/library/writtenBy> ?author .
  ?copy <http://example.com/theme/library/locatedAt> ?branch .
}
GROUP BY ?author
HAVING (COUNT(?loan) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?member) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?target { "Author 1" "Author 2" }
  ?member a lib:Member .
  ?loan a lib:Loan ; lib:borrowedBy ?member ; lib:loanedCopy ?copy .
  ?book lib:hasCopy ?copy ; lib:writtenBy ?author .
  ?author lib:name ?authorName .
  FILTER(?authorName = ?target || ?authorName = "Author 3")
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?loan lib:dueDate ?due .
                      FILTER(?due < "2024-01-10"^^xsd:date) }
  OPTIONAL { ?book lib:title ?optTitle . }
  FILTER(?optTitle != "")
}

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?branch) AS ?count) WHERE {
  { ?branch a lib:Branch . }
  UNION
  { ?branch a lib:Branch ; lib:name ?name . }
  OPTIONAL { ?copy lib:locatedAt ?branch . BIND(?copy AS ?optCopy) }
  FILTER(?optCopy != ?branch)
  MINUS { ?branch lib:name ?name2 .
          FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name2)), "branch 0")) }
}

  ?person a schema:Person .

}

  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .

  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  VALUES ?personPosition { "1"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "2"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "3"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "4"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "5"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> }
  ?person <https://schema.org/position> ?personPosition .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person <https://schema.org/award> ?optAward .
  }
  BIND(?personPosition AS ?positionBucket)
}

  }

### Original Query ###
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?entity) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?entity a schema:Person ;
            schema:position ?position .
    FILTER(?position IN (1, 2, 3))
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?entity a schema:WebPage ;
            schema:position ?position .
    FILTER(?position IN (1, 2, 3))
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?entity schema:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?optName) || ?optName != "")
}

    ?entity <https://schema.org/position> ?position .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?entity a <https://schema.org/WebPage> .
    VALUES ?position { "1"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "2"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "3"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> }
    ?entity <https://schema.org/position> ?position .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?entity <https://schema.org/name> ?optName .
  }
  FILTER (!(BOUND(?optName)) || (?optName != ""))
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .
  ?topic schema:mainEntityOfPage ?page .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?work schema:review ?review .
    OPTIONAL {
      ?review schema:reviewRating ?rating .
      ?rating schema:ratingValue ?stars .
      FILTER(?stars IN (4, 5))
      BIND(?stars AS ?optStars)
      OPTIONAL { ?rating schema:ratingCount ?ratingCount . }
    }
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?person schema:award ?optAward . }
  OPTIONAL { ?org schema:employee ?optEmployee . }
}

SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
  ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
  ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?work <https://schema.org/review> ?review .
    OPTIONAL {
      ?review <https://schema.org/reviewRating> ?rating .
      VALUES ?stars { "4"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "5"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> }
      ?rating <https://schema.org/ratingValue> ?stars .
      BIND(?stars AS ?optStars)
      OPTIONAL {
        ?rating <https://schema.org/ratingCount> ?ratingCount .
      }
    }
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person <https://schema.org/award> ?optAward .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?optEmployee .
  }
}

  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .

  ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  OPTIONAL {

    OPTIONAL {

  }
  OPTIONAL {

  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?optEmployee .
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .
  ?topic schema:mainEntityOfPage ?page .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?org schema:employee ?employee .
    BIND(?employee AS ?optEmployee)
  }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?optEmployee) || ?optEmployee != ?org)
  OPTIONAL { ?page schema:event ?event . }
}

SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
  ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
  ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?employee .
    BIND(?employee AS ?optEmployee)
  }
  FILTER (!(BOUND(?optEmployee)) || (?optEmployee != ?org))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?page <https://schema.org/event> ?event .
  }
}

PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>

  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .

  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .

  }

  OPTIONAL { ?work schema:position ?workPosition . }
}

SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
  ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
  ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person <https://schema.org/knows> ?known .
    BIND(?known AS ?optKnown)
  }
  FILTER (!(BOUND(?optKnown)) || (?optKnown != ?person))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?work <https://schema.org/position> ?workPosition .
  }
}

  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .

### Original Query ###
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?review) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .
  ?topic schema:mainEntityOfPage ?page .
  ?work schema:review ?review .
  ?review schema:reviewRating ?rating .
  ?rating schema:ratingValue ?ratingValue .
  FILTER(?ratingValue IN (1, 2, 3))
  BIND(?ratingValue AS ?ratingBucket)
  OPTIONAL { ?rating schema:ratingCount ?optRatingCount . }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?review) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
  ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
  ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  ?work <https://schema.org/review> ?review .
  ?review <https://schema.org/reviewRating> ?rating .
  VALUES ?ratingValue { "1"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "2"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "3"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> }
  ?rating <https://schema.org/ratingValue> ?ratingValue .
  BIND(?ratingValue AS ?ratingBucket)
}

PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?fanout) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .
  ?topic schema:mainEntityOfPage ?page .
  {
    ?work schema:review ?review .
    BIND(?review AS ?fanout)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?page schema:event ?event .
    BIND(?event AS ?fanout)
  }
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?org schema:employee ?fanout . }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?fanout) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
    ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
    ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
    ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
    ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
    ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
    ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
    ?work <https://schema.org/review> ?review .
    BIND(?review AS ?fanout)
    FILTER NOT EXISTS {
      ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?fanout .
    }
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
    ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
    ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
    ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
    ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
    ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
    ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
    ?page <https://schema.org/event> ?event .
    BIND(?event AS ?fanout)
    FILTER NOT EXISTS {
      ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?fanout .
    }
  }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?fanout) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
    ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
    ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
    ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
    ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
    ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
    ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
    ?work <https://schema.org/review> ?review .
    BIND(?review AS ?fanout)
    FILTER NOT EXISTS {
      ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?fanout .
    }
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
    ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
    ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
    ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
    ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
    ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
    ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
    ?page <https://schema.org/event> ?event .
    BIND(?event AS ?fanout)
    FILTER NOT EXISTS {
      ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?fanout .
    }
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .
  ?topic schema:mainEntityOfPage ?page .
  OPTIONAL {
    {
      ?work schema:position ?optRank .
      FILTER(?optRank IN (1, 2, 3))
    }
    UNION
    {
      ?page schema:position ?optRank .
      FILTER(?optRank IN (7, 8, 9))
    }
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?person schema:award ?optAward . }
}

  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .

  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .

  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .

    {

  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person <https://schema.org/award> ?optAward .
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?person) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .
  ?topic schema:mainEntityOfPage ?page .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?person schema:award ?optAward .
  }
  FILTER(?optAward != "")
  BIND(?optAward AS ?awardBinding)
  OPTIONAL { ?work schema:review ?review . }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?person) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
  ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
  ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/award> ?optAward .
  FILTER (?optAward != "")
  BIND(?optAward AS ?awardBinding)
}

PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .

  OPTIONAL {
    ?page schema:event ?event .
    ?event schema:position ?eventPosition .
    FILTER(?eventPosition IN (1, 2, 3, 4))

  OPTIONAL { ?org schema:employee ?optEmployee . }
}

SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .
  ?department <https://schema.org/makesOffer> ?offer .
  ?offer <https://schema.org/itemOffered> ?work .
  ?work <https://schema.org/about> ?topic .
  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?page <https://schema.org/event> ?event .
    VALUES ?eventPosition { "1"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "2"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "3"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "4"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> }
    ?event <https://schema.org/position> ?eventPosition .
    BIND(?eventPosition AS ?eventBucket)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?org <https://schema.org/employee> ?optEmployee .
  }
}

  ?org <https://schema.org/department> ?department .

  ?topic <https://schema.org/mainEntityOfPage> ?page .
  ?person <https://schema.org/memberOf> ?org .
  ?person a <https://schema.org/Person> .
  OPTIONAL {

    VALUES ?eventPosition { "1"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "2"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "3"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> "4"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#int> }
    ?event <https://schema.org/position> ?eventPosition .
    BIND(?eventPosition AS ?eventBucket)
  }
  OPTIONAL {

  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person a schema:Person .
  ?person schema:memberOf ?org .
  ?org schema:department ?department .
  ?department schema:makesOffer ?offer .
  ?offer schema:itemOffered ?work .
  ?work schema:about ?topic .
  ?topic schema:mainEntityOfPage ?page .
  OPTIONAL {
    {
      ?work schema:review ?shared .
    }
    UNION
    {
      ?page schema:event ?shared .
    }
    OPTIONAL { ?shared a ?sharedType . }
  }
  ?person schema:identifier ?personIdentifier .
  FILTER(?personIdentifier IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7))
}

  ?component a eng:Component .
  OPTIONAL { ?component eng:partOf ?assembly . BIND(?assembly AS ?optAssembly) }
  FILTER(?optAssembly != ?component)

}

  UNION

  OPTIONAL { ?entity eng:partOf ?assembly . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX eng: <http://example.com/theme/engineering/>
SELECT ?assembly (COUNT(DISTINCT ?component) AS ?componentCount) WHERE {
  ?assembly a eng:Assembly ; eng:name ?assemblyName .
  FILTER(?assemblyName IN ("Assembly 1", "Assembly 2", "Assembly 3"))
  OPTIONAL { ?component eng:partOf ?assembly . }
}
GROUP BY ?assembly
HAVING(COUNT(?component) > 0)

SELECT ?assembly (COUNT(DISTINCT ?component) AS ?componentCount) WHERE {
  ?assembly a <http://example.com/theme/engineering/Assembly> .
  VALUES ?assemblyName { "Assembly 1" "Assembly 2" "Assembly 3" }
  ?assembly <http://example.com/theme/engineering/name> ?assemblyName .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?component <http://example.com/theme/engineering/partOf> ?assembly .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?assembly
HAVING (COUNT(?component) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX eng: <http://example.com/theme/engineering/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?requirement) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?requirement a eng:Requirement ; eng:satisfies ?component .
  OPTIONAL { ?requirement eng:verifiedBy ?test . BIND(?test AS ?optTest) }
  FILTER(?optTest != ?requirement)
  MINUS { ?component eng:name ?name . FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?name), "Component 1")) }
}

PREFIX eng: <http://example.com/theme/engineering/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?component) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?component a eng:Component ; eng:name ?name .
  FILTER(?name = "Component 1" || ?name = "Component 2")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?component eng:dependsOn ?dep . }
  OPTIONAL { ?component eng:partOf ?assembly . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX eng: <http://example.com/theme/engineering/>
SELECT ?component (COUNT(DISTINCT ?requirement) AS ?reqCount) WHERE {
  { ?requirement a eng:Requirement ; eng:satisfies ?component . }
  UNION
  { ?component a eng:Component . }
  OPTIONAL { ?component eng:dependsOn ?dep . BIND(?dep AS ?optDep) }
  FILTER(?optDep != ?component)
}
GROUP BY ?component
HAVING(COUNT(?requirement) > 0)

  }
}

  ?requirement a <http://example.com/theme/engineering/Requirement> .

  }

    ?test <http://example.com/theme/engineering/verifiedBy> ?measurement .
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX eng: <http://example.com/theme/engineering/>
SELECT ?component (COUNT(DISTINCT ?requirement) AS ?reqCount) WHERE {
  ?component a eng:Component ; eng:partOf ?assembly .
  OPTIONAL { ?component eng:dependsOn ?dep . BIND(?dep AS ?optDep) }
  FILTER(?optDep != ?component)
  ?requirement a eng:Requirement ; eng:satisfies ?component .
}
GROUP BY ?component
HAVING(COUNT(?requirement) >= 1)

PREFIX eng: <http://example.com/theme/engineering/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?requirement) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?threshold { 0.85 }
  ?requirement a eng:Requirement ; eng:verifiedBy ?test .
  ?test eng:verifiedBy ?measurement .
  ?measurement eng:measuredValue ?value .
  FILTER(?value IN (0.85, 0.9, 0.95))
  FILTER EXISTS { ?requirement eng:satisfies ?component . }
  OPTIONAL { ?component eng:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(?optName != "")
}

PREFIX eng: <http://example.com/theme/engineering/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?assembly) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?assembly a eng:Assembly ; eng:name ?name .
  FILTER(?name = "Assembly 1" || ?name = "Assembly 2")
  OPTIONAL { ?component eng:partOf ?assembly . BIND(?component AS ?optComponent) }
  FILTER(?optComponent != ?assembly)
  MINUS { ?requirement eng:satisfies ?component . }
}

  ?node a conn:Node .
  OPTIONAL { ?node conn:connectsTo ?neighbor . BIND(?neighbor AS ?optNeighbor) }
  FILTER(?optNeighbor != ?node)
  OPTIONAL { ?node conn:weight ?w . }
}

  ?node a conn:Node .
  OPTIONAL { ?node conn:weight ?w . BIND(?w AS ?optWeight) }
  FILTER(?optWeight > 5)
  MINUS { ?node conn:connectsTo ?neighbor . FILTER(?neighbor = ?node) }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX conn: <http://example.com/theme/connected/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?node) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?node a conn:Node ; conn:weight ?w .
  FILTER(?w = 1 || ?w = 2)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?node conn:connectsTo ?neighbor . }
  OPTIONAL { ?neighbor conn:connectsTo ?node . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX conn: <http://example.com/theme/connected/>
SELECT ?node (COUNT(DISTINCT ?neighbor) AS ?neighborCount) WHERE {
  { ?node a conn:Node ; conn:connectsTo ?neighbor . }
  UNION
  { ?neighbor conn:connectsTo ?node . }
  OPTIONAL { ?node conn:weight ?w . BIND(?w AS ?optWeight) }
  FILTER(?optWeight != 0)
}
GROUP BY ?node
HAVING(COUNT(?neighbor) > 0)

SELECT ?node (COUNT(DISTINCT ?neighbor) AS ?neighborCount) WHERE {
  {
    ?node a <http://example.com/theme/connected/Node> .
    ?node <http://example.com/theme/connected/connectsTo> ?neighbor .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?neighbor <http://example.com/theme/connected/connectsTo> ?node .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?node <http://example.com/theme/connected/weight> ?w .
    BIND(?w AS ?optWeight)
  }
  FILTER (?optWeight != 0)
}
GROUP BY ?node
HAVING (COUNT(?neighbor) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX conn: <http://example.com/theme/connected/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?node) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?node a conn:Node ; conn:weight ?w .
  FILTER(?w = 8 || ?w = 9)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?node conn:connectsTo ?neighbor . }
  MINUS { ?neighbor conn:connectsTo ?node . FILTER(?neighbor = ?node) }
}

PREFIX conn: <http://example.com/theme/connected/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?node) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?node a conn:Node ; conn:connectsTo ?mid .
  ?mid conn:connectsTo ?end .
  OPTIONAL { ?node conn:weight ?optWeight . }
  FILTER(?optWeight IN (7, 8, 9))
  FILTER EXISTS { ?end conn:connectsTo ?node . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX conn: <http://example.com/theme/connected/>
SELECT ?node (COUNT(DISTINCT ?neighbor) AS ?degree) WHERE {
  { ?node conn:connectsTo ?neighbor . }
  UNION
  { ?neighbor conn:connectsTo ?node . }
  OPTIONAL { ?neighbor conn:weight ?w . BIND(?w AS ?optWeight) }
  FILTER(?optWeight != 0)
}
GROUP BY ?node
HAVING(COUNT(?neighbor) > 1)

SELECT ?node (COUNT(DISTINCT ?neighbor) AS ?degree) WHERE {
  ?node (<http://example.com/theme/connected/connectsTo>|^<http://example.com/theme/connected/connectsTo>) ?neighbor .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?neighbor <http://example.com/theme/connected/weight> ?w .
    BIND(?w AS ?optWeight)
  }
  FILTER (?optWeight != 0)
}
GROUP BY ?node
HAVING (COUNT(?neighbor) > 1)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX conn: <http://example.com/theme/connected/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?node) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?threshold { 3 }
  ?node a conn:Node ; conn:weight ?w .
  FILTER(?w IN (1, 2, 3, 4))
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?node conn:connectsTo ?n2 .
                      ?n2 conn:weight ?w2 . FILTER(?w2 < ?threshold) }
  MINUS { ?node conn:connectsTo ?node . }
}

PREFIX train: <http://example.com/theme/train/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?line (COUNT(DISTINCT ?section) AS ?sectionCount) WHERE {
  ?line a train:Line ; train:name ?lineName .
  FILTER(?lineName IN ("Line 0", "Line 1", "Line 2"))
  OPTIONAL { ?section train:partOfLine ?line . }
}
GROUP BY ?line
HAVING(COUNT(?section) > 0)

SELECT ?line (COUNT(DISTINCT ?section) AS ?sectionCount) WHERE {
  ?line a <http://example.com/theme/train/Line> .
  VALUES ?lineName { "Line 0" "Line 1" "Line 2" }
  ?line <http://example.com/theme/train/name> ?lineName .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?section <http://example.com/theme/train/partOfLine> ?line .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?line
HAVING (COUNT(?section) > 0)

PREFIX train: <http://example.com/theme/train/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

  ?section a train:SectionOfLine ; train:partOfLine ?line .

}

  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?service train:scheduledTime ?late . FILTER(?late > ?threshold) }
}

PREFIX train: <http://example.com/theme/train/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?line (COUNT(DISTINCT ?service) AS ?serviceCount) WHERE {
  { ?service a train:TrainService ; train:runsOnSection ?section .
    ?section train:partOfLine ?line . }
  UNION
  { ?line a train:Line . }
  OPTIONAL { ?line train:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(?optName != "")
}
GROUP BY ?line
HAVING(COUNT(?service) > 0)

SELECT ?line (COUNT(DISTINCT ?service) AS ?serviceCount) WHERE {
  {
    ?service a <http://example.com/theme/train/TrainService> .
    ?service <http://example.com/theme/train/runsOnSection> ?section .
    ?section <http://example.com/theme/train/partOfLine> ?line .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?line a <http://example.com/theme/train/Line> .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?line <http://example.com/theme/train/name> ?optName .
  }
  FILTER (?optName != "")
}
GROUP BY ?line
HAVING (COUNT(?service) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX train: <http://example.com/theme/train/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?op) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?op a train:OperationalPoint ; train:name ?name .
  FILTER(?name = "OP 1" || ?name = "OP 2")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?service train:passesThrough ?op . }
  MINUS { ?op train:name ?name2 . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name2)), "op 0")) }
}

  }

}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX train: <http://example.com/theme/train/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?section (COUNT(DISTINCT ?track) AS ?trackCount) WHERE {
  ?section a train:SectionOfLine ; train:hasTrackSection ?track .
  OPTIONAL { ?section train:connectsOperationalPoint ?op . BIND(?op AS ?optOp) }
  FILTER(?optOp != ?section)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?track a train:TrackSection . }
}
GROUP BY ?section
HAVING(COUNT(?track) > 0)

SELECT ?section (COUNT(DISTINCT ?track) AS ?trackCount) WHERE {
  ?section a <http://example.com/theme/train/SectionOfLine> .
  ?section <http://example.com/theme/train/hasTrackSection> ?track .

    ?track a <http://example.com/theme/train/TrackSection> .
  }
  ?section <http://example.com/theme/train/connectsOperationalPoint> ?op .
  BIND(?op AS ?optOp)
  FILTER (?optOp != ?section)
}
GROUP BY ?section
HAVING (COUNT(?track) > 0)

PREFIX train: <http://example.com/theme/train/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?op) AS ?count) WHERE {
  { ?op a train:OperationalPoint . }
  UNION
  { ?op a train:OperationalPoint ; train:name ?name . }
  OPTIONAL { ?section train:connectsOperationalPoint ?op . BIND(?section AS ?optSection) }
  FILTER(?optSection != ?op)
  MINUS { ?op train:name ?name2 . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name2)), "op 1")) }
}

PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>

  ?substation a grid:Substation .
  OPTIONAL { ?generator grid:feeds ?substation ; grid:capacity ?cap . BIND(?cap AS ?optCap) }

  OPTIONAL { ?substation grid:name ?name . }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>
SELECT ?transformer (COUNT(DISTINCT ?meter) AS ?meterCount) WHERE {
  ?transformer a grid:Transformer ; grid:feeds ?substation .
  ?substation grid:name ?name .
  FILTER(?name IN ("Substation 0", "Substation 1", "Substation 2"))
  OPTIONAL { ?transformer grid:hasMeter ?meter . }
}
GROUP BY ?transformer
HAVING(COUNT(?meter) > 0)

SELECT ?transformer (COUNT(DISTINCT ?meter) AS ?meterCount) WHERE {
  ?transformer <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
  VALUES ?name { "Substation 0" "Substation 1" "Substation 2" }
  ?substation <http://example.com/theme/grid/name> ?name .
  ?transformer a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Transformer> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?transformer <http://example.com/theme/grid/hasMeter> ?meter .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?transformer
HAVING (COUNT(?meter) > 0)

PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>

  ?meter a grid:Meter ; grid:measures ?load .
  OPTIONAL { ?load grid:loadValue ?value . BIND(?value AS ?optValue) }

}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?meter) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?meter a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Meter> .
  ?meter <http://example.com/theme/grid/measures> ?load .
  ?load <http://example.com/theme/grid/loadValue> ?value .
  BIND(?value AS ?optValue)
  FILTER (?optValue > 100)
  MINUS {
    ?meter <http://example.com/theme/grid/measures> ?load2 .
    {
      {
        ?load2 <http://example.com/theme/grid/loadValue> ?value2 .
        FILTER (?value2 > 180)
      }
    }
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?line) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?line a grid:Line ; grid:connectsTo ?substation .
  ?substation grid:name ?name .
  FILTER(?name = "Substation 0" || ?name = "Substation 1")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?line grid:connectsTo ?other . }
  OPTIONAL { ?line grid:connectsTo ?other2 . }
}

PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?generator) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?threshold { 700 }
  ?generator a grid:Generator ; grid:capacity ?capacity .
  FILTER(?capacity IN (700, 800, 900))
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?generator grid:capacity ?cap2 . FILTER(?cap2 < ?threshold) }
}

SELECT ?substation (COUNT(DISTINCT ?asset) AS ?assetCount) WHERE {
  {
    ?asset a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Transformer> .
    ?asset <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?asset a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Generator> .
    ?asset <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?asset <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
    BIND(?substation AS ?optSub)
  }
  FILTER (?optSub != ?asset)
}
GROUP BY ?substation
HAVING (COUNT(?asset) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?transformer) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?transformer a grid:Transformer ; grid:feeds ?substation .
  ?substation grid:name ?name .
  FILTER(?name = "Substation 0" || ?name = "Substation 1")
  FILTER EXISTS { ?transformer grid:hasMeter ?meter . }
  MINUS { ?meter grid:measures ?load . FILTER(?load = ?substation) }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?transformer) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?transformer <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
  VALUES ?name { "Substation 0" "Substation 1" }
  ?substation <http://example.com/theme/grid/name> ?name .
  ?transformer a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Transformer> .
  FILTER EXISTS {
    ?transformer <http://example.com/theme/grid/hasMeter> ?meter .
  }
  MINUS {
    ?meter <http://example.com/theme/grid/measures> ?load .
    FILTER (?load = ?substation)
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>
SELECT ?substation (COUNT(DISTINCT ?transformer) AS ?transformerCount) WHERE {
  ?substation a grid:Substation ; grid:name ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?substation grid:feeds ?transformer . BIND(?transformer AS ?optTransformer) }
  FILTER(?optTransformer != ?substation)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?transformer grid:hasMeter ?meter . }
}
GROUP BY ?substation
HAVING(COUNT(?transformer) > 0)

SELECT ?substation (COUNT(DISTINCT ?transformer) AS ?transformerCount) WHERE {
  ?substation a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Substation> .
  ?substation <http://example.com/theme/grid/name> ?name .
  ?substation <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?transformer .
  BIND(?transformer AS ?optTransformer)
  FILTER ((?optTransformer != ?substation) && EXISTS { ?transformer <http://example.com/theme/grid/hasMeter> ?meter . })
}
GROUP BY ?substation
HAVING (COUNT(?transformer) > 0)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX grid: <http://example.com/theme/grid/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?line) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?line a grid:Line ; grid:capacity ?cap .
  FILTER(?cap IN (500, 600, 700))
  OPTIONAL { ?line grid:connectsTo ?substation . }
  MINUS { ?line grid:capacity ?cap2 . FILTER(?cap2 < 500) }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?disease { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/0> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/1> }
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/studiesDisease> ?disease .
  ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/pValue> ?p .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/effectSize> ?effect .
  FILTER ((?p < 0.05) || (?effect > 0.7))
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker> ?marker .
  BIND(?marker AS ?optMarker)
  FILTER (?optMarker != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/999>)
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?disease { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/0> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/1> }
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/studiesDisease> ?disease .
  ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/pValue> ?p .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/effectSize> ?effect .
  FILTER ((?p < 0.05) || (?effect > 0.7))
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker> ?marker .
  BIND(?marker AS ?optMarker)
  FILTER (?optMarker != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/999>)
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?combo (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?drugCount) WHERE {
  ?combo a pharma:Combination ; pharma:combinationOf ?drug ; pharma:synergyScore ?score .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?drug pharma:hasSideEffect ?sideEffect .
    ?sideEffect pharma:severity ?sev .
    BIND(?sev AS ?optSeverity)
  }
  FILTER(?optSeverity IN ("Mild", "Moderate"))
  FILTER(?score > 0.7)
}
GROUP BY ?combo
HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) >= 2)

SELECT ?combo (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?drugCount) WHERE {
  ?combo a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Combination> .
  ?combo <http://example.com/theme/pharma/synergyScore> ?score .
  FILTER (?score > 0.7)
  ?combo <http://example.com/theme/pharma/combinationOf> ?drug .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasSideEffect> ?sideEffect .
  ?sideEffect <http://example.com/theme/pharma/severity> ?sev .
  BIND(?sev AS ?optSeverity)
  FILTER (?optSeverity IN ("Mild", "Moderate"))
}
GROUP BY ?combo
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) >= 2)

SELECT ?combo (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?drugCount) WHERE {
  ?combo a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Combination> .
  ?combo <http://example.com/theme/pharma/synergyScore> ?score .
  FILTER (?score > 0.7)
  ?combo <http://example.com/theme/pharma/combinationOf> ?drug .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasSideEffect> ?sideEffect .
  ?sideEffect <http://example.com/theme/pharma/severity> ?sev .
  BIND(?sev AS ?optSeverity)
  FILTER (?optSeverity IN ("Mild", "Moderate"))
}
GROUP BY ?combo
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) >= 2)

PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?target (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?drugCount) WHERE {
  ?target a pharma:Target ; pharma:inPathway ?pathway .
  ?drug a pharma:Drug ; pharma:targets ?target .
  OPTIONAL { ?drug pharma:indicatedFor ?disease . BIND(?disease AS ?optDisease) }
  FILTER(?optDisease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/2>,
                         <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/3>))
  FILTER EXISTS { ?trial pharma:hasArm ?arm . ?arm pharma:armDrug ?drug . }
}
GROUP BY ?target
HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) > 2)

  ?target a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Target> .
  ?target <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inPathway> ?pathway .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/targets> ?target .
  ?drug a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Drug> .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/indicatedFor> ?disease .
  BIND(?disease AS ?optDisease)
  FILTER ((?optDisease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/2>, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/3>)) && EXISTS { ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm . ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug . })
}
GROUP BY ?target
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) > 2)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?drug ?disease WHERE {
  ?trial a pharma:ClinicalTrial ; pharma:studiesDisease ?disease ; pharma:hasArm ?arm .
  ?arm pharma:armDrug ?drug ; pharma:hasResult ?result .
  ?result pharma:responseRate ?rate .
  FILTER(?rate > 0.6)
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?drug pharma:indicatedFor ?disease . }
  OPTIONAL { ?drug pharma:targets ?target . BIND(?target AS ?optTarget) }
  FILTER(?optTarget != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/target/0>)
}

SELECT ?drug ?disease WHERE {
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/responseRate> ?rate .
  FILTER (?rate > 0.6)
  ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/studiesDisease> ?disease .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/indicatedFor> ?disease .
  }
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/targets> ?target .
  BIND(?target AS ?optTarget)
  FILTER (?optTarget != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/target/0>)
}

SELECT ?drug ?disease WHERE {
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/responseRate> ?rate .
  FILTER (?rate > 0.6)
  ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/studiesDisease> ?disease .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/indicatedFor> ?disease .
  }
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/targets> ?target .
  BIND(?target AS ?optTarget)
  FILTER (?optTarget != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/target/0>)
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  { ?drug a pharma:Drug ; pharma:hasMolecule ?mol . }
  UNION
  { ?combo a pharma:Combination ; pharma:combinationOf ?drug .
    ?drug pharma:hasMolecule ?mol . }
  ?mol pharma:inClass ?class .
  OPTIONAL { ?class pharma:name ?optName . BIND(?optName AS ?optClassName) }
  FILTER(?optClassName != "")
  MINUS { ?drug pharma:contraindicatedFor ?disease .
          FILTER(?disease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/4>,
                              <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/5>)) }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?drug a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Drug> .
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
    ?mol <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inClass> ?class .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?combo a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Combination> .
    ?combo <http://example.com/theme/pharma/combinationOf> ?drug .
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
    ?mol <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inClass> ?class .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?class <http://example.com/theme/pharma/name> ?optName .
    BIND(?optName AS ?optClassName)
  }
  FILTER (?optClassName != "")
  MINUS {
    VALUES ?disease { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/4> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/5> }
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/contraindicatedFor> ?disease .
  }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?drug a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Drug> .
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
    ?mol <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inClass> ?class .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?combo a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Combination> .
    ?combo <http://example.com/theme/pharma/combinationOf> ?drug .
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
    ?mol <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inClass> ?class .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?class <http://example.com/theme/pharma/name> ?optName .
    BIND(?optName AS ?optClassName)
  }
  FILTER (?optClassName != "")
  MINUS {
    VALUES ?disease { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/4> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/5> }
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/contraindicatedFor> ?disease .
  }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?trial) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?marker { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/0> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/1> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/2> }
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker> ?marker .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/pValue> ?p .
  FILTER ((?p < 0.05) || (?p = 0.05))
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
  ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/effectSize> ?effect .
  BIND(?effect AS ?optEffect)
  FILTER (?optEffect > 0.3)
}

  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker> ?marker .

  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
  ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .

  FILTER (?optEffect > 0.3)
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?combo (COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) AS ?sharedTargets) WHERE {
  ?combo a pharma:Combination ; pharma:combinationOf ?drugA ; pharma:combinationOf ?drugB .
  FILTER(?drugA != ?drugB)
  ?drugA pharma:targets ?target .
  ?drugB pharma:targets ?target .
  OPTIONAL { ?drugA pharma:hasSideEffect ?sideEffect . BIND(?sideEffect AS ?optSideEffect) }
  FILTER(?optSideEffect != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/side-effect/0>)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?drugB pharma:hasSideEffect ?sideEffect2 . }
}
GROUP BY ?combo
HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) > 1)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?arm) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?trial a pharma:ClinicalTrial ; pharma:hasArm ?arm .
  { ?arm pharma:armComparator ?comp . }
  UNION
  { ?arm pharma:armDrug ?comp . }
  OPTIONAL { ?comp pharma:name ?optName . BIND(?optName AS ?optCompName) }
  FILTER(?optCompName != "")
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?arm pharma:hasResult ?r . ?r pharma:pValue ?p .
                      FILTER(?p IN (0.08, 0.09)) }
}

    ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .

    ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
    ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?comp .

  OPTIONAL {

### Original Query ###
PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?drug (COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) AS ?targetCount) WHERE {
  ?drug a pharma:Drug ; pharma:targets ?target .
  OPTIONAL { ?drug pharma:hasMolecule ?mol . BIND(?mol AS ?optMol) }
  FILTER(?optMol != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/molecule/0>)
  MINUS { ?drug pharma:contraindicatedFor ?disease .
          FILTER(?disease = <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/6>
                 || ?disease = <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/7>) }
}
GROUP BY ?drug
HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) >= 3)

SELECT ?drug (COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) AS ?targetCount) WHERE {
  ?drug a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Drug> .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/targets> ?target .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
  BIND(?mol AS ?optMol)
  FILTER (?optMol != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/molecule/0>)
  MINUS {
    {
      ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/contraindicatedFor> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/6> .
      FILTER (sameTerm(?disease, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/6>))
    }
    UNION
    {
      ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/contraindicatedFor> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/7> .
      FILTER (sameTerm(?disease, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/7>))
    }
  }
}
GROUP BY ?drug
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) >= 3)

SELECT ?drug (COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) AS ?targetCount) WHERE {
  ?drug a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Drug> .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/targets> ?target .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
  BIND(?mol AS ?optMol)
  FILTER (?optMol != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/molecule/0>)
  MINUS {
    {
      ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/contraindicatedFor> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/6> .
      FILTER (sameTerm(?disease, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/6>))
    }
    UNION
    {
      ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/contraindicatedFor> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/7> .
      FILTER (sameTerm(?disease, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/7>))
    }
  }
}
GROUP BY ?drug
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?target) >= 3)

### Original Query ###
PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?drug (AVG(?effect) AS ?avgEffect) WHERE {
      ?trial a pharma:ClinicalTrial ; pharma:hasArm ?arm .
      ?arm pharma:armDrug ?drug ; pharma:hasResult ?result .
      ?result pharma:effectSize ?effect .
      OPTIONAL { ?result pharma:responseRate ?rate . BIND(?rate AS ?optRate) }
      FILTER(?optRate > 0.2)
    }
    GROUP BY ?drug
    HAVING(AVG(?effect) > 0.4)
  }
  FILTER EXISTS { ?drug pharma:hasSideEffect ?se . }
  OPTIONAL { ?drug pharma:indicatedFor ?disease . BIND(?disease AS ?optDisease) }
  FILTER(?optDisease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/8>,
                         <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/9>))
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?drug (AVG(?effect) AS ?avgEffect) WHERE {
      ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
      ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
      ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
      ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
      ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/effectSize> ?effect .
      ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/responseRate> ?rate .
      BIND(?rate AS ?optRate)
      FILTER (?optRate > 0.2)
    }
    GROUP BY ?drug
    HAVING (AVG(?effect) > 0.4)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/indicatedFor> ?disease .
    BIND(?disease AS ?optDisease)
  }
  FILTER ((?optDisease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/8>, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/9>)) && EXISTS { ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasSideEffect> ?se . })
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?drug (AVG(?effect) AS ?avgEffect) WHERE {
      ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
      ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
      ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
      ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
      ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/effectSize> ?effect .
      ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/responseRate> ?rate .
      BIND(?rate AS ?optRate)
      FILTER (?optRate > 0.2)
    }
    GROUP BY ?drug
    HAVING (AVG(?effect) > 0.4)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/indicatedFor> ?disease .
    BIND(?disease AS ?optDisease)
  }
  FILTER ((?optDisease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/8>, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/9>)) && EXISTS { ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasSideEffect> ?se . })
}

PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?pathway (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?drugCount) WHERE {
  VALUES ?marker { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/3>
                   <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/4> }
  ?drug a pharma:Drug ; pharma:targets ?target .
  ?target pharma:inPathway ?pathway .
  OPTIONAL { ?drug pharma:testedIn ?trial . BIND(?trial AS ?optTrial) }
  FILTER(?optTrial != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/trial/0>)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?trial pharma:hasArm ?arm . ?arm pharma:hasResult ?result .
                  ?result pharma:biomarker ?marker . }
}
GROUP BY ?pathway
HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) > 1)

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?entity) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?entity a <http://example.com/theme/medical/Condition> .
    ?entity <http://example.com/theme/medical/code> ?code .
    VALUES ?target { "DX-200" "DX-201" }
    FILTER ((?code = ?target) || (?code = "DX-202"))

    ?entity a <http://example.com/theme/medical/Medication> .

    VALUES ?target { "DX-200" "DX-201" }
    FILTER ((?code = ?target) || (?code = "DX-202"))
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?entity <http://example.com/theme/medical/code> ?alt .
  }
}

PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?practitioner (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?encCount) WHERE {
  ?enc a med:Encounter ; med:handledBy ?practitioner ; med:recordedOn ?date .
  FILTER(?date IN ("2024-01-01"^^xsd:date, "2024-02-01"^^xsd:date))
  OPTIONAL { ?enc med:hasCondition ?cond . }
}
GROUP BY ?practitioner
HAVING(COUNT(?enc) > 0)

SELECT ?practitioner (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?encCount) WHERE {
  ?enc a <http://example.com/theme/medical/Encounter> .
  ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/handledBy> ?practitioner .
  ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/recordedOn> ?date .
  FILTER (?date IN ("2024-01-01"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date>, "2024-02-01"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date>))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasCondition> ?cond .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?practitioner
HAVING (COUNT(?enc) > 0)

  FILTER(?optValue > 60)
  MINUS { ?patient med:name ?name . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), "test")) }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX med: <http://example.com/theme/medical/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?patient (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?encCount) WHERE {
  ?patient a med:Patient .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?patient med:hasEncounter ?enc .
    ?enc med:handledBy ?practitioner .
    BIND(?practitioner AS ?optPractitioner)
  }
  FILTER(?optPractitioner != ?patient)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?enc med:hasCondition ?cond . }
}
GROUP BY ?patient
HAVING(COUNT(?enc) >= 2)

SELECT ?patient (COUNT(DISTINCT ?enc) AS ?encCount) WHERE {
  ?patient a <http://example.com/theme/medical/Patient> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?patient <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasEncounter> ?enc .
    ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/handledBy> ?practitioner .
    BIND(?practitioner AS ?optPractitioner)
  }
  FILTER ((?optPractitioner != ?patient) && EXISTS { ?enc <http://example.com/theme/medical/hasCondition> ?cond . })
}
GROUP BY ?patient
HAVING (COUNT(?enc) >= 2)

}

  ?loan a <http://example.com/theme/library/Loan> .

    BIND(?due AS ?optDue)
  }
  FILTER (?optDue > "2024-01-10"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date>)
  MINUS {
    ?member <http://example.com/theme/library/name> ?name .
    FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), "member 1"))
  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?member (COUNT(DISTINCT ?loan) AS ?loanCount) WHERE {
  { ?loan a lib:Loan ; lib:borrowedBy ?member . }
  UNION
  { ?member a lib:Member . }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?loan lib:loanedCopy ?copy .
    BIND(?copy AS ?optCopy)
  }
  FILTER(?optCopy != ?member)
}
GROUP BY ?member
HAVING(COUNT(?loan) > 0)

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?member) AS ?count) WHERE {
  VALUES ?target { "Author 1" "Author 2" }
  ?member a lib:Member .

  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?loan lib:dueDate ?due .
                      FILTER(?due < "2024-01-10"^^xsd:date) }
  OPTIONAL { ?book lib:title ?optTitle . }
  FILTER(?optTitle != "")
}

  ?loan <http://example.com/theme/library/borrowedBy> ?member .
  ?member a <http://example.com/theme/library/Member> .
  ?loan a <http://example.com/theme/library/Loan> .
  ?loan <http://example.com/theme/library/loanedCopy> ?copy .
  ?book <http://example.com/theme/library/hasCopy> ?copy .
  ?book <http://example.com/theme/library/writtenBy> ?author .
  ?author <http://example.com/theme/library/name> ?authorName .
  VALUES ?target { "Author 1" "Author 2" }
  FILTER ((?authorName = ?target) || (?authorName = "Author 3"))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?book <http://example.com/theme/library/title> ?optTitle .
  }
  FILTER ((?optTitle != "") && NOT EXISTS { ?loan <http://example.com/theme/library/dueDate> ?due . FILTER (?due < "2024-01-10"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date>) })
}

PREFIX lib: <http://example.com/theme/library/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

  { ?branch a lib:Branch . }
  UNION
  { ?branch a lib:Branch ; lib:name ?name . }
  OPTIONAL { ?copy lib:locatedAt ?branch . BIND(?copy AS ?optCopy) }
  FILTER(?optCopy != ?branch)
  MINUS { ?branch lib:name ?name2 .
          FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name2)), "branch 0")) }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?branch) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?branch a <http://example.com/theme/library/Branch> .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?branch a <http://example.com/theme/library/Branch> .
    ?branch <http://example.com/theme/library/name> ?name .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?copy <http://example.com/theme/library/locatedAt> ?branch .
    BIND(?copy AS ?optCopy)
  }
  FILTER (?optCopy != ?branch)
  MINUS {
    ?branch <http://example.com/theme/library/name> ?name2 .
    FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name2)), "branch 0"))
  }
}

}

SELECT ?component (COUNT(DISTINCT ?requirement) AS ?reqCount) WHERE {
  {
    ?requirement a <http://example.com/theme/engineering/Requirement> .
    ?requirement <http://example.com/theme/engineering/satisfies> ?component .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?component a <http://example.com/theme/engineering/Component> .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?component <http://example.com/theme/engineering/dependsOn> ?dep .
    BIND(?dep AS ?optDep)
  }
  FILTER (?optDep != ?component)
}
GROUP BY ?component
HAVING (COUNT(?requirement) > 0)

SELECT ?component (COUNT(DISTINCT ?requirement) AS ?reqCount) WHERE {
  ?requirement <http://example.com/theme/engineering/satisfies> ?component .
  ?component a <http://example.com/theme/engineering/Component> .
  ?requirement a <http://example.com/theme/engineering/Requirement> .
  ?component <http://example.com/theme/engineering/partOf> ?assembly .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?component <http://example.com/theme/engineering/dependsOn> ?dep .
    BIND(?dep AS ?optDep)
  }
  FILTER (?optDep != ?component)
}
GROUP BY ?component
HAVING (COUNT(?requirement) >= 1)

  ?requirement a <http://example.com/theme/engineering/Requirement> .

}

  }
}

SELECT ?node (COUNT(DISTINCT ?neighbor) AS ?neighborCount) WHERE {
  {
    ?node a <http://example.com/theme/connected/Node> .
    ?node <http://example.com/theme/connected/connectsTo> ?neighbor .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?neighbor <http://example.com/theme/connected/connectsTo> ?node .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?node <http://example.com/theme/connected/weight> ?w .
    BIND(?w AS ?optWeight)
  }
  FILTER (?optWeight != 0)
}
GROUP BY ?node
HAVING (COUNT(?neighbor) > 0)

}

  }
}

### Original Query ###
PREFIX train: <http://example.com/theme/train/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?line (COUNT(DISTINCT ?service) AS ?serviceCount) WHERE {
  { ?service a train:TrainService ; train:runsOnSection ?section .
    ?section train:partOfLine ?line . }
  UNION
  { ?line a train:Line . }
  OPTIONAL { ?line train:name ?optName . }
  FILTER(?optName != "")
}
GROUP BY ?line
HAVING(COUNT(?service) > 0)

}

HAVING(COUNT(?track) > 0)

  ?substation a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Substation> .

  }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?meter) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?meter a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Meter> .
  ?meter <http://example.com/theme/grid/measures> ?load .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?load <http://example.com/theme/grid/loadValue> ?value .
    BIND(?value AS ?optValue)
  }
  FILTER (?optValue > 100)
  MINUS {
    ?meter <http://example.com/theme/grid/measures> ?load2 .
    {
      {
        ?load2 <http://example.com/theme/grid/loadValue> ?value2 .
        FILTER (?value2 > 180)
      }
    }
  }
}

}

SELECT ?substation (COUNT(DISTINCT ?asset) AS ?assetCount) WHERE {
  {
    ?asset a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Transformer> .
    ?asset <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?asset a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Generator> .
    ?asset <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?asset <http://example.com/theme/grid/feeds> ?substation .
    BIND(?substation AS ?optSub)
  }
  FILTER (?optSub != ?asset)
}
GROUP BY ?substation
HAVING (COUNT(?asset) > 0)

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?line) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?line <http://example.com/theme/grid/capacity> ?cap .
  FILTER (?cap IN (500, 600, 700))
  ?line a <http://example.com/theme/grid/Line> .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?line <http://example.com/theme/grid/connectsTo> ?substation .
  }
  MINUS {
    ?line <http://example.com/theme/grid/capacity> ?cap2 .
    FILTER (?cap2 < 500)
  }
}

SELECT ?drug ?disease WHERE {
  ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
  ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/studiesDisease> ?disease .
  ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
  ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/responseRate> ?rate .
  FILTER (?rate > 0.6)
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {

  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/targets> ?target .
    BIND(?target AS ?optTarget)
  }
  FILTER (?optTarget != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/target/0>)
}

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

  { ?drug a pharma:Drug ; pharma:hasMolecule ?mol . }

  { ?combo a pharma:Combination ; pharma:combinationOf ?drug .

          FILTER(?disease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/4>,
                              <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/5>)) }
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    ?drug a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Drug> .
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
    ?mol <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inClass> ?class .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?combo a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Combination> .
    ?combo <http://example.com/theme/pharma/combinationOf> ?drug .
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasMolecule> ?mol .
    ?mol <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inClass> ?class .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?class <http://example.com/theme/pharma/name> ?optName .
    BIND(?optName AS ?optClassName)
  }
  FILTER (?optClassName != "")
  MINUS {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/contraindicatedFor> ?disease .
    FILTER (?disease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/4>, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/5>))
  }
}

  ?trial a pharma:ClinicalTrial ; pharma:hasArm ?arm .

  OPTIONAL { ?result pharma:effectSize ?effect . BIND(?effect AS ?optEffect) }
  FILTER(?optEffect > 0.3)
  FILTER(?p < 0.05 || ?p = 0.05)
}

PREFIX pharma: <http://example.com/theme/pharma/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?drug (AVG(?effect) AS ?avgEffect) WHERE {
      ?trial a pharma:ClinicalTrial ; pharma:hasArm ?arm .
      ?arm pharma:armDrug ?drug ; pharma:hasResult ?result .
      ?result pharma:effectSize ?effect .
      OPTIONAL { ?result pharma:responseRate ?rate . BIND(?rate AS ?optRate) }

  }
  FILTER EXISTS { ?drug pharma:hasSideEffect ?se . }

  FILTER(?optDisease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/8>,
                         <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/9>))
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?count) WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?drug (AVG(?effect) AS ?avgEffect) WHERE {
      ?trial a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/ClinicalTrial> .
      ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm .
      ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result .
      ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/armDrug> ?drug .
      ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/effectSize> ?effect .
      OPTIONAL {
        ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/responseRate> ?rate .
        BIND(?rate AS ?optRate)
      }
      FILTER (?optRate > 0.2)
    }
    GROUP BY ?drug
    HAVING (AVG(?effect) > 0.4)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/indicatedFor> ?disease .
    BIND(?disease AS ?optDisease)
  }
  FILTER ((?optDisease IN (<http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/8>, <http://example.com/theme/pharma/disease/9>)) && EXISTS { ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasSideEffect> ?se . })
}

SELECT ?pathway (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?drugCount) WHERE {
  VALUES ?marker { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/3>
                   <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/4> }
  ?drug a pharma:Drug ; pharma:targets ?target .

  FILTER EXISTS { ?trial pharma:hasArm ?arm . ?arm pharma:hasResult ?result .
                  ?result pharma:biomarker ?marker . }

SELECT ?pathway (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) AS ?drugCount) WHERE {
  ?target <http://example.com/theme/pharma/inPathway> ?pathway .
  ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/targets> ?target .
  ?drug a <http://example.com/theme/pharma/Drug> .
  VALUES ?marker { <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/3> <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker/4> }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?drug <http://example.com/theme/pharma/testedIn> ?trial .
    BIND(?trial AS ?optTrial)
  }
  FILTER ((?optTrial != <http://example.com/theme/pharma/trial/0>) && EXISTS { ?arm <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasResult> ?result . ?trial <http://example.com/theme/pharma/hasArm> ?arm . ?result <http://example.com/theme/pharma/biomarker> ?marker . })
}
GROUP BY ?pathway
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?drug) > 1)
